company_facts: Gravidade Zero (GZero) is a culture, future-of-work and AI/technology consultancy operating online and in-person (presencial), with engagements ranging from a few hours up to 1–12 months.

Methodology is systemic: they investigate organizational culture via interviews, observations and context analysis, looking at what sustains, blocks or drives culture, then co-create solutions aligned with the day-to-day reality of the people who live it.
Positioning centers on strengthening the symbiosis between human and technology and on human-machine convergence — being amplified, not swallowed, by the evolution of AI.
They build bespoke digital platforms/apps for internal teams or clients to sustain actions and keep culture in motion.
Offers facilitated international immersions, e.g. agenda-building and in-person accompaniment by Renan and Dante to Silicon Valley (Vale do Silício).
